Messages.Author: Remy Auclair
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Vampire A strikes hand
Vamp B plays the Jones
Can vamp A strikes hand again ?

( "...The opposing minion gets a new opportunity to declare a
strike."...) Can it be the same strike ?

Thanks for your time,

Rémy

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>Vampire A strikes hand
>Vamp B plays the Jones
>Can vamp A strikes hand again ?
>
>( "...The opposing minion gets a new opportunity to declare a
>strike."...) Can it be the same strike ?

Yes it can. If you strike with hands or a weapon and it is Jones'ed, nothing
prevents you from choosing that same strike again. (Though if you played a
card, you'll need another copy of that card if you want to do that strike).

BTW: If a Gas-Powered Chainsaw strike, Treasured Samadji dodge, or Brass
Knuckles is chosen for a strike and is canceled, does this count as being
"used?" Thanks!

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <20011004024545...@mb-mq.aol.com>, Halcyan 2
<halc...@aol.com> writes

>BTW: If a Gas-Powered Chainsaw strike, Treasured Samadji dodge, or Brass
>Knuckles is chosen for a strike and is canceled, does this count as being
>"used?"

In the case of Gas Powered Chainsaw, I'm tempted to go with the White
Phosphorus Grenade rulings. Burn after use is burn after the strike
resolves; hence use is not "select for strike" but "perform strike".
Same with Brass Knuckles, Sawed Off Shotgun and Chainsaw.

Since it's "may dodge as a strike" with Treasured Samadji, it's harder
to rule along the same way. However, since the vampire hasn't "dodged
as a strike", merely chosen "dodge as a strike", it seems reasonable to
allow it to be selected again.
